verdict.rationale: Trigger.dev's triggers are code-based (task.trigger() calls, cron schedules, webhooks configured by developers) rather than pre-built no-code connectors to apps like Gmail, Typeform, or Salesforce for ops users to wire up. Community feedback explicitly contrasts it with Zapier/IFTTT/n8n-style app-linking platforms, confirming it's a developer background-job tool, not an ops-facing app-event trigger platform.
